## Supplemental Figure 6C
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, supp_6C}
CFSE_palette <- c("CFSE_pos" = '#fa9f42', "CFSE_neg" = '#6F4E37', 'Other' = '#000000')

excel_file <- glue('/projects/home/tlchan/combo_mlr_all_lineage_CFSE_abundance.xlsx')

abundance <- read.xlsx(excel_file, sheet = "abundance")
pt_res <- read.xlsx(excel_file, sheet = "CFSEposvCFSEneg_pt")

fp <- ggplot(pt_res, aes(x = Difference, y = factor(lineage), color = color)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbarh(mapping = aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high, height = 0)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    guides(color = "none") +
    xlab("Log2FC") +
    ylab("Lineage") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 20)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = CFSE_palette)

bp <- ggplot(abundance, aes(x = proportion + 1, y = factor(lineage), fill = Channel)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge(), aes(fill = Channel), size = 2) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    labs(fill = "CFSE") +
    xlab("Percent sample + 1") +
    ylab("") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size = 20)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = CFSE_palette)
ggarrange(fp, bp, ncol = 2, nrow = 1, widths = c(0.5, 1.0), common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")
ggsave("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/supp_6c.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
```

## Supplemental Figure 6D
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, supp_6D}
DC_palette <- c("DC1" = '#4B3F72', "DC2" = '#00916E', "DC: PIGR, RORC" = '#FFC857')

excel_file <- glue('/projects/home/tlchan/combo_mlr_all_CFSE_neg_lineage_DC_type_abundance.xlsx')

abundance <- read.xlsx(excel_file, sheet = "abundance") %>% mutate(DC_type = gsub("newDC", "DC: PIGR, RORC", DC_type))

ggplot(data = abundance, aes(y = factor(lineage), x = proportion + 1, fill = DC_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_jitter(data = abundance, aes(fill = patient_id, group = DC_type), pch = 21, size = 2.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = DC_palette) +
    labs(fill = "DC Type") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    ylab("Lineages") +
    xlab("Percent sample + 1") +
    ggtitle(glue("Proportion by lineage, CFSE-")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/supp_6d.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
```

## Supplemental Figure 6G, I
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, supp_6GI}
# Use Reds
reds_colormap <- read.table('/projects/home/tlchan/util/cmaps/reds_cmap.txt', header = FALSE)
reds_hex <- apply(reds_colormap, 1, function(row) {
    rgb(row[1], row[2], row[3], maxColorValue = 1)
})

lineage_list <- list(cd8 = "g", cd4 = "i")

for (lineage in names(lineage_list)) {
    gene_order <- read.xlsx('/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/metadata/MLR_dotplot.xlsx', sheet = toupper(lineage)) %>%
        filter(!is.na(genes)) %>%
        pull(genes) %>%
        strsplit(",") %>%
        unlist()

    lin_gex <- read.csv(glue('/projects/home/tlchan/combo_mlr_{lineage}_gene_exp.csv')) %>%
        mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = gene_order), Cluster = factor(Cluster))

    ggplot(lin_gex, aes(x = Gene, y = fct_rev(Cluster), fill = Count, size = Percent_Expressed)) +
        geom_point(color = "black", shape = 21) +
        ylab('Cluster') +
        labs(size = "% Expressed", fill = "Scaled expression") +
        scale_fill_gradientn(colors = reds_hex) +
        lims(size = c(0, 100)) +
        theme_light(base_size = 25) +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
        theme(legend.key.size = unit(.4, "cm"), legend.title = element_text(size = 20), legend.text = element_text(size = 12))
    width <- length(unique(lin_gex$Gene)) / 4 + 7.5
    height <- length(unique(lin_gex$Cluster)) / 2 + 2

    ggsave(glue("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/supp_6{lineage_list[[lineage]]}.pdf"), width = width, height = height)
}
```

## Supplemental Figure 6J
```{r message = F, results = F, warning = F, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, supp_6J}
cfse_neg_res <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/mlr_degs/lineage_level/combo_mlr_DC2vDC1_paired/combo_mlr_DC2vDC1_paired_CFSE_neg_de_by_DC2vDC1_paired_all_results.csv")
cfse_pos_res <- read.csv("/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/mlr_degs/lineage_level/combo_mlr_DC2vDC1_paired/combo_mlr_DC2vDC1_paired_CFSE_pos_de_by_DC2vDC1_paired_all_results.csv")

mlr_meta <- read.csv('/projects/home/tlchan/projects/ascites/second_data_freeze/data/mlr_degs/pb_objects/combo_mlr_lineage_pseudobulk_meta.csv', row.names = 1)
cfse_neg_meta <- mlr_meta %>%
    filter(CFSE == "CFSE_neg") %>%
    filter(DC_type == "DC1" | DC_type == "DC2")
cfse_pos_meta <- mlr_meta %>%
    filter(CFSE == "CFSE_pos") %>%
    filter(DC_type == "DC1" | DC_type == "DC2")

pdf("/projects/home/tlchan/fig_panels/supp_6j.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
plot_lineage_deg(res = cfse_neg_res,
                 meta = cfse_neg_meta,
                 lin = "All CFSE- cells",
                 contrast = "DC_type",
                 ref_var = "DC1",
                 test_var = "DC2",
                 ref_color = "#4B3F72",
                 test_color = "#00916E")
plot_lineage_deg(res = cfse_pos_res,
                 meta = cfse_pos_meta,
                 lin = "All CFSE+ cells",
                 contrast = "DC_type",
                 ref_var = "DC1",
                 test_var = "DC2",
                 ref_color = "#4B3F72",
                 test_color = "#00916E")
dev.off()
```
